lines: As a candidate for this exam, you configure solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 customer experience apps. You understand:
- An organization’s sales processes and the seller’s perspective.
- AI-driven features to enhance seller efficiency.
- End-to-end marketing functions and how they support sales.
You streamline business processes, improve automation, and accelerate sales operations. You are responsible for:
- Configuring the standard and premium features of Dynamics 365 Sales.
- Implementing collaboration tools to enhance teamwork.
- Tailoring Dynamics 365 Sales to business needs.
- Extending functionality with Microsoft Power Platform.
- Supporting sales processes using Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys.
You should have proficiency in Dynamics 365 Sales and are familiar with:
- Configure and customize Dataverse and model-driven apps (35–40%)
- Extend and enhance Dynamics 365 Sales capabilities (10–15%)
#### Configure core functionality of Dynamics 365 Sales
- Enable and configure predictive lead and opportunity scoring
- Configure and deploy the Sales mobile app
- Demonstrate sales order processing, including quotes, orders, and invoices
- Configure lead and opportunity status reasons
- Configure automatic creation rules for leads
- Manage the product lifecycle, including creating, revising, cloning, and retiring
- Customize the enhanced experience for adding products
- Create price lists, discount lists, and product pricing
- Differentiate standard and premium Sales Insights features
- Configure relationship analytics and improve relationship health
- Configure the Sales accelerator for an organization and users
- Manage the sales pipeline by using the work list
- Configure the Sales accelerator record types
### Configure and customize Dataverse and model-driven apps (35–40%)
#### Perform tasks and manage settings in the Power Platform Environment Settings app
- Use the Dataverse connector in a cloud flow
- Embed Power BI dashboard, reports, and tiles
- Differentiate between types of Power Apps
- Create and configure visualizations for model-driven apps
- Create and manage owner and access teams
- Evaluate security privileges by using access checker
- Manage Microsoft Entra ID groups in Dataverse
- Create and manage column security profiles and column-level security
#### Configure core functionality of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys
- Create and personalize marketing emails by using templates and email editor
- Create and manage text messages in journeys
- Create journeys using unified profiles and segments from Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data
- Configure consent management including Compliance Profiles and Consent Center
- Differentiate segments in Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Insights - Journeys, and Customer Insights - Data
- Create and manage event registration forms
### Extend and enhance Dynamics 365 Sales capabilities (10–15%)
#### Manage sales data and interactions in Outlook
- Perform common tasks including tracking records, creating records, adding sales literature and knowledge articles, and applying email templates
- Customize the Dynamics 365 App for Outlook
